Frequently asked questions

Before we get started.

Can you help with content?

Content structure and copywriting can be discussed during project planning. Deliverables are defined in the scope.

Can you build more than a brochure website?

Yes. E-commerce, landing pages, web applications and integration requirements can be explored. Scope, ownership and dependencies are agreed before development.

Can you improve our existing website?

Yes. A modernization engagement can review design, usability, performance, functionality and maintenance needs before proposing changes.

Will the website work on mobile?

Responsive layouts are part of the proposed approach. Devices and user journeys should be included in acceptance testing.

Do you promise search rankings?

No. Technical SEO foundations can be implemented, but rankings depend on many factors and are not guaranteed.
